what: Hovering one grid cell makes only that cell sharp over .25s power3.out, while the other cells blur by 6px after .05s over .25s quad.out and the repeating motion inside the cells stops — hovering the “clear” cell (the name text cell) makes everything sharp again. Even after the pointer leaves the board, only the last chosen cell stays sharp

options.dur: Time to blur out and sharpen back (s), default .25
options.release: If ”all”, everything turns crisp when leaving the panel — default stays as is (original)
options.fade: Opacity of blurred cells (0–1), default 1 (unchanged) — another site uses .5
options.ease: Blur-out curve, default quad.out — also accepts numeric values like ”0.42,0,0.58,1”
options.sharp-dur: Duration of coming into focus (seconds), default same as dur — 0 is immediate (as in the original)
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Cell — hover over a cell with data-clear (such as a name-letter cell) and all of them turn sharp
options.[data-fx-part=blur]: (Optional) Panel that blurs inside the cell — if absent, the cell itself (add an inner panel to avoid blurring cell lines and labels)
options..is-fx-dim · .is-fx-focus: Class added to blurred cells and touched cells — used by the caller to pause and play the animation
options.fx:focus: On the board when a touched cell changes { tile }
options.clear: Cell selector that keeps everything sharp, default [data-clear]

note: Not attached on touch devices (everything stays sharp, no blur)

from.where: index.html #grid — original ProjectThumb.thumbActive (blur 0, .25s power3.out) · thumbInactive (blur 6px, after .05s then .25s quad.out). Hovering a letter cell makes all of them active, and the board’s mouseleave blurs everything only when a work is open

index.html·detail.html .lt-works__tiles — original AllWorks tile flips a different tile’s .blur on every mouseenter·leave (filter blur 42.5px·opacity .5, transition all .2s ease-in-out .22s applies only to .blur, so it moves only when blurring and releases immediately). As a part, blur: 42.5; fade: .5; dur: .2; lag: .22; ease: 0.42,0,0.58,1; sharp-dur: 0; release: all
